title: Table rewind machine
statement: For an alphabet $\Gamma$, a natural number $k$ of work tapes, and a work-tape index $i$, define the table-rewind machine to be the seam composition of the backward-skip machine and the start-seeking machine, using the designated done and run states, respectively.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is an index among the $k$ work tapes
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the component machines or seam composition, so the resulting machine's behavior cannot be stated more explicitly.
